in_marathi.name: Sharwanikaal
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Wisdom and Power
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sharwanikaal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sharwanikaal is a combination of two Sanskrit words - Sharwa meaning 'God of Wisdom' and Kal meaning 'Time' or 'Power'. Thus, Sharwanikaal represents the God who embodies both wisdom and power.
